LanguageData.HR_AncientOak.label: Ancient Oak
LanguageData.HR_AncientOak.description: A venerable oak with a broad crown and heavy trunk. Its in-game name describes an ecological type, not a verified age of exactly one thousand years.
LanguageData.HR_AncientPine.label: Scaled Ancient Pine
LanguageData.HR_AncientPine.description: A tall, densely crowned ancient pine. Its in-game name describes an ecological type rather than a specific historical specimen.
LanguageData.HR_AncientCamphor.label: Ancient Camphor
LanguageData.HR_AncientCamphor.description: A large camphor tree adapted to warm and humid environments.
LanguageData.HR_AncientBanyan.label: Ancient Banyan
LanguageData.HR_AncientBanyan.description: A broad-crowned banyan adapted to the warmer southern regions.
